name: Brightfield
summary: A B2B solar sales dashboard and CRM with a live solar-day arc and a quote builder
about: A sales dashboard and CRM for a team that sells to other businesses, shown with sample data from a Pakistani solar company. Soft raised panels hold a live solar day where the sun follows the clock and fleet output updates, a drag-and-drop pipeline from lead to signed contract, and a quote builder that sizes a system from the power bill.
how: Open a page from the sidebar; on a phone use the menu button.
On Overview, watch the sun follow the time of day, or drag the Scrub the day slider to see output at any hour; press Live to return.
On Pipeline, drag a deal tile into the next tray; dropping it on Signed books the kilowatts. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
On Quote builder, move the power bill, roof area and sun hours sliders: panels pop onto the roof, price and payback update, and Save as proposal adds a deal.
Installs shows live output per site; open one to see its day curve or switch it into maintenance.
Search, filter and sort Accounts, then edit or delete them with undo.
Settings holds pricing for quotes, alert switches, the theme and Reset demo data.
